## 1. Verdict
Real malformed AIFF fixture (parent `aiff_pcm_s16be_44k1_st.aiff`, 2ch/44.1k
s16be). Consumed by crates/demux/tests/wav_aiff_fixtures.rs via a
format!()-built name — so plain rg for the literal name finds nothing; the
consumer table entry proves use. Two integrity gaps: it is not listed in
tests/fixtures/generated/MANIFEST.toml (xtask `--check` does not pin it),
and its lack of extension makes tests/compat/src/corpus.rs `walk_root` skip
it (media_extensions filter) — the compat matrix never runs it.

## 3. Findings
F-001 [S3]
Where: tests/fixtures/generated/malformed/aiff_pcm_s16be_44k1_st__flip16 (whole file) + tests/compat/compat-matrix.json committed_roots
What is wrong: The file has no extension. tests/compat/src/corpus.rs `walk_root` keeps only names matching `media_extensions` (corpus.rs:131-137), so this fixture — unlike every `.mp4`/`.avi`/`.mkv` sibling — is never collected by the compat harness. Same for its 8 extension-less aiff/ogg/wav siblings.
Why it matters: The compat-matrix "malformed corpus" coverage silently excludes three whole families (aiff/ogg/wav derivatives); the matrix overstates malformed-format breadth.
What correct looks like: either give the derivatives their family extension (`.aiff`) or add a name-pattern (not just extension) match to walk_root.
Confidence: HIGH — Verification: read + traced the filter code.
F-002 [S3]
Where: same file vs tests/fixtures/generated/MANIFEST.toml
What is wrong: Not in MANIFEST.toml (only the 28 avi/mp4 rows are). No hash pin, no drift gate. Generated by a different (python, ffmpeg-authored per docs/worklog/archive-2026-10.md:8587-style provenance) lane whose ledger lives elsewhere; nothing in-tree verifies these bytes today.
Confidence: HIGH — Verification: read MANIFEST (28 entries, none aiff/ogg/wav).
